name: CS SO Discount Check
script:
# BRD §4 FR-4-01, BR-OE-01 — Auto-trigger discount approval if any line exceeds threshold
threshold = doc.cs_discount_threshold or 10.0
max_discount = max((item.discount_percentage or 0) for item in doc.items) if doc.items else 0

# Auto-flag RC customers
customer_rc = frappe.db.get_value('Customer', doc.customer, 'cs_rc_customer') or 0
if customer_rc:
    doc.cs_rc_customer = 1

# Discount gate
if (max_discount > threshold and
        doc.cs_discount_approval_status not in ('Approved',)):
    doc.cs_discount_approval_status = 'Discount Approval — Sales Head'
    frappe.msgprint(
        f'Discount of {max_discount:.1f}% exceeds threshold of {threshold:.0f}%. '
        f'Sales Head approval required before order can proceed. (BR-OE-01)',
        alert=True, indicator='orange'
    )

# Credit hold check
if doc.customer and doc.grand_total:
    credit_limit = frappe.db.get_value('Customer Credit Limit',
        {'parent': doc.customer}, 'credit_limit') or 0
    if credit_limit:
        outstanding = frappe.db.sql('''
            SELECT IFNULL(SUM(outstanding_amount), 0)
            FROM `tabSales Invoice`
            WHERE customer=%s AND docstatus=1 AND outstanding_amount > 0
        ''', doc.customer)[0][0] or 0
        if outstanding + (doc.grand_total or 0) > credit_limit:
            doc.cs_credit_hold_status = 'On Hold'
            doc.cs_credit_hold_reason = (
                f'Outstanding ₹{outstanding:,.0f} + Order ₹{doc.grand_total:,.0f} '
                f'exceeds credit limit ₹{credit_limit:,.0f}. Finance release required. (BR-OE-02)'
            )
            frappe.msgprint(
                f'Order placed on Credit Hold. Outstanding ₹{outstanding:,.0f} '
                f'exceeds limit ₹{credit_limit:,.0f}.',
                alert=True, indicator='red'
            )
        else:
            if doc.cs_credit_hold_status == 'On Hold':
                pass  # keep hold — only Finance can release
            else:
                doc.cs_credit_hold_status = 'Clear'

name: CS DN Attach Client Order Confirmation
script:
# BRD v1.2 CR-08 FR-SO-15(d): Auto-attach Client Order Confirmation(s) to DN
# Reads the Sales Order's cs_mandate_documents rows tagged 'Client Order Confirmation'
# (multi-file) and attaches each file to this Delivery Note (dedupe by file_url).
so_name = ''
for item in doc.items:
    if item.get('against_sales_order'):
        so_name = item.against_sales_order
        break
if so_name:
    rows = frappe.get_all('CS Mandate Document',
        filters={'parenttype': 'Sales Order', 'parent': so_name,
                 'document_type': 'Client Order Confirmation'},
        fields=['file'])
    for r in rows:
        coc = r.get('file') or ''
        if not coc:
            continue
        already = frappe.db.exists('File', {
            'attached_to_doctype': 'Delivery Note',
            'attached_to_name': doc.name,
            'file_url': coc
        })
        if already:
            continue
        orig = frappe.db.get_value('File', {'file_url': coc}, 'file_name')
        nf = frappe.get_doc({
            'doctype': 'File',
            'file_name': orig or coc.split('/')[-1],
            'file_url': coc,
            'attached_to_doctype': 'Delivery Note',
            'attached_to_name': doc.name,
            'is_private': 0,
            'folder': 'Home/Attachments',
        })
        nf.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        nf.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
